# ScreenForge

> ScreenForge is a free AI screen recorder with zoom animation and an AI video editor built in, for macOS, Windows and Linux. Record your screen, webcam or (on a Mac) an iPhone or iPad, or drop in any MP4 or MOV, then ask for the edit in plain language: cuts, zooms, speed, captions, music, backgrounds and voice-over. Or fine-tune it by hand on the timeline.

ScreenForge is made for tutorials, product demos, lessons, promos, talking-head videos and async video messages. It is free to try: record, edit and export twice before you pay.

## Pages

- [Home](https://screenforge.studio/): what ScreenForge does, with a demo of the AI agent editing a screencast from one prompt
- [Download](https://screenforge.studio/download): installers for macOS 14 or later, Windows 10 or later, and Linux (.deb and tar.gz)
- [Pricing](https://screenforge.studio/pricing): free trial; ElevenLabs voices and share links are free; Pro at US$20/month with the AI editing agent and 1,000 credits a month; Creator license at US$49 once. Includes the FAQ
- [Comparison](https://screenforge.studio/comparison): Jam vs Screen Studio vs ScreenForge, a Screen Studio alternative for Windows and Linux
- [AI agents](https://screenforge.studio/agents): connect Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP client to ScreenForge's MCP server to record the screen and edit videos from your own agent; Claude Code plugin at github.com/smartloop-labs/screenforge-plugins
- [Changelog](https://screenforge.studio/changelog/): every version and what changed, with an Atom feed at /changelog/feed.xml
- [Privacy policy](https://screenforge.studio/privacy): what stays on your computer and when the app goes online
- [Spanish site](https://screenforge.studio/es/)
- [Full text](https://screenforge.studio/llms-full.txt): the main pages above as one Markdown file

## Features

- AI editing agent: describe the edit ("cut the ums and long pauses", "zoom on my clicks", "get this under a minute") and it makes it
- AI voice-over narration, with on-device voices or studio-quality ElevenLabs voices
- My voice: clone your own voice once and narrate in it (ElevenLabs, with your consent)
- Voice-over recording on its own track, plus clean-up and re-voicing
- Automatic captions with on-device Whisper
- Automatic zooms that follow your clicks, and a smooth cursor with six styles
- Camera recording with face tracking
- Microphone boost (+6, +12 or +18 dB) with a limiter
- Backgrounds, color grading, crop, blur and highlight masks, keyboard shortcut overlay
- iPhone and iPad recording on macOS, with device frames
- Edit any MP4, MOV or M4V; import Loom videos from a share link
- Share links that play in any browser; AI-written titles, descriptions and tags for YouTube
- Export to MP4 (H.264 or HEVC), ProRes, WebM or GIF, up to 4K
- MCP server for your own AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex): record, edit and export from the agent
